{"code": "import re
exp=open('experiment_log.txt').read().strip()
prev=open('previous_study_log.txt').read().strip()
exp_obs=[o.strip() for o in re.split(r'(?:^|(?<=\))Observation ', exp) if o]
prev_obs=[o.strip() for o in re.split(r'(?:^|(?<=\))Observation ', prev) if o]
print('Experiment Observations:', exp_obs)
print('Previous Observations:', prev_obs)
# Identify anomalies
exp_anom=[o for o in exp_obs if 'Anomaly' in o]
prev_anom=[o for o in prev_obs if 'Anomaly' in o]
print('Experiment anomalies:', exp_anom)
print('Previous anomalies:', prev_anom)
# Compare anomaly counts
print('Count experiment anomalies:', len(exp_anom), 'vs previous:', len(prev_anom))
# Novel findings: anomalies present in experiment but not in previous
novel=[o for o in exp_anom if o not in prev_anom]
print('Novel anomalies:', novel)"}
